ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; visible surface area is predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with high-intensity pixels limited to specular water reflections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate internal pixel angle of 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular low-amplitude serrations visible along the distal edge of the left lobe; right lobe edge appears smoother with minimal pixel-level peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Highly asymmetrical; the left lobe follows a broad, concave-to-blunt-convex trajectory, while the right lobe exhibits a slender, elongated convex curve tapering to a sharp distal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast white pixel spots visible on the distal margin of the left lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant morphological truncation and ragged distal termination of the left fluke lobe, including a distinct brownish-textured mass/encrustation at the far left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme bilateral asymmetry in lobe width and distal morphology; right lobe is significantly longer and more tapered than the left.
